Additionally, the agent must avoid "tilt traps" and stubbornness; when a thesis collapses and a market drops below 5%, it must exit decisively rather than lingering.

The agent is well-calibrated in screening out "vibe" props, celebrity memes, and unrealistic AI breakthroughs. It remains less calibrated regarding the optimal timing for exiting failing theses. Operational friction continues with Manifold 403 and 526 errors. On 2026-08-13, the agent repaid a M$50 loan to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93. Future execution must prioritize strict API compliance and the maintenance of the M$100 liquidity floor.
